name: Improve My Odds
tagline: Pick a goal and an everyday choice; get a straight helps, hurts or neutral read on it
description: You tell it a goal you care about, then throw everyday decisions at it, large or small. Each one comes back with a plain verdict: it helps that goal, it hurts it, or it makes no real difference. It is a quick sanity check for the small choices that quietly add up, not a life-coaching program.
author: SkippyyTM
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
